177.name: Yes
177.description: Typically a style accent, a smaller flap pocket located above the right flap pocket.

328.name: Standard Flap (5.5cm)
328.description: This style features a standard 5.5cm flap of fabric over a jetted pocket which can be let out or tucked in.

329.name: Large Flap (6.5cm)
329.description: This style features a large 6.5cm flap of fabric over a jetted pocket which can be let out or tucked in.

330.name: Jetted
330.description: Formal and sleek, jetted pockets are defined by a fine trimmed slit cut into the fabric.

331.name: Patch
331.description: A sportier take on the more typical flap pocket, patch pockets offer a more relaxed appeal.

333.name: Round Patch
333.description: This take on the casual patch pocket features a curved bottom.

336.name: Tulip Patch
336.description: Tulip pockets are patch pockets with a prominent curve in the opening for an added touch of flair.

517.name: 2mm
517.description: Found along the edges of the hem, pockets and lapel to prevent fabric curling.

518.name: 6mm
518.description: Found 6mm in, along the edges of the hem, pockets and lapel to prevent fabric curling.

521.name: Natural
521.description: The highly versatile natural shoulder features minimal padding for a balanced finish.

522.name: Natural Pleated
522.description: This natural shoulder offers a softer silhouette & features small handmade pleats along the armhole seam.

523.name: Lightly Padded Pleated
523.description: This classic lightly padded shoulder features a series of small handmade pleats along the armhole seam.

524.name: Lightly Padded
524.description: A traditional shoulder, lightly padded shoulder for a classic silhouette.

525.name: Structured
525.description: A structured shoulder features strong, defined shoulder line for an elegant and enhanced silhouette.

526.name: Natural Shirt
526.description: This natural shoulder joins the sleeve head underneath the shoulder seam for a more shirt-like fit.

527.name: Unconstructed
527.description: Crafted without padding, an unconstructed shoulder is regarded as the most casual of styles.

600.name: Boat Shape
600.description: Named after the Italian word for "little boat", barchetta pockets are subtly curved chest pockets.

601.name: Patch
601.description: Chest patch pockets offer a more easygoing and practical alternative to more formal options.

603.name: Rounded Patch
603.description: Chest patch pockets offer a more casual alternative to more formal options—this style is rounded.

697.name: Full Canvas
697.description: This cotton canvas lines the full jacket for added shape, drape & structure.

700.name: Half Canvas
700.description: This cotton canvas lines half the jacket for added shape, drape & structure.

702.name: Unconstructed
702.description: Crafted without canvas, unconstructed jackets offer a sporty, lightweight and comfortable wear.

782.name: Butterfly Lining
782.description: A hand-stitched finish on unstructured jackets covering only the upper back.

783.name: Full Lined
783.description: Features a linking throughout the entirety of a jacket's body and arms.

784.name: Half Lined
784.description: Features a linking throughout the top half of a jacket's interior, including the arms.

785.name: Unlined
785.description: Unlined jackets feature lining only in the sleeves, with none throughout the body.

794.name: 1 Button
794.description: Ideal for black-tie, elegantly tapered and provides a well-tailored silhouette.

795.name: 2 Button
795.description: The standard 2-button jacket makes for a versatile and modern appeal.

796.name: 2.5 Button
796.description: 2.5-button jackets feature a 3rd button on the lapel roll, primarily used for aesthetic purposes.

798.name: 4 Button Double Breasted
798.description: Offers a younger, more tailored version of the classic fit.

799.name: 6 Button Double Breasted
799.description: A tailored, modern double-breasted fit with an extra touch of timeless formality.

800.name: 6 Button Low Double Breasted
800.description: A bold 6-button fit with a low-cut closure for a timeless, sporty appeal.

818.name: Notch
818.description: The most standard and versatile lapel works well for any occasion.

819.name: Concave
819.description: A slightly widened notch lapel that features a subtle curvature.

820.name: Peak
820.description: Peak lapels broaden the shoulders and are more angular with a bold upward peak.

822.name: Straight Peak
822.description: Provides a sharp, strong aesthetic that broadens the shoulders.

926.name: Traditional
926.description: The traditional lapel buttonhole, or boutonniere, is used today as a way to place flowers on the lapel.

927.name: Handmade Milanese
927.description: This hand-sewn lapel buttonhole is a subtle, yet distinguished, accent with a sartorial history.

938.name: 3 kissing buttons
938.description: These 3 kissing buttons are slightly overlapping for a sartorial accent.

939.name: 4 kissing buttons
939.description: These 4 kissing buttons are slightly overlapping for a sartorial accent.

941.name: 5 kissing buttons
941.description: These 5 kissing buttons are slightly overlapping for a sartorial accent.

1084.name: Narrow
1084.description: This Narrow lapel width measures in at 8.6cm.

1085.name: Standard
1085.description: The standard lapel width for our Notch lapels. Measuring in at 9.8cm, it is equivalent to our Havana fit.

1086.name: Wide
1086.description: This Wide lapel width measures in at 10.8cm.

1087.name: Standard
1087.description: The Standard width for our Notch-Concave lapel. Measuring in at 11.5cm, it is equivalent to our Roma fit.

1088.name: Narrow
1088.description: Our narrow Rounded Peak lapels measure in at 9cm.

1089.name: Standard
1089.description: The standard width for our Rounded Peak lapels, measuring in at 11cm.

1090.name: Narrow
1090.description: Our narrow Straight Peak lapels measure in at 9cm in Single Breasted closures, while Double Breasted are 9.5cm.

1091.name: Standard
1091.description: Standard Straight Peak lapels measure in at 10.5cm in Single Breasted, while Double Breasted measures in at 11.5cm.

1098.name: Low Gorge Notch
1098.description: This low-gorge notch lapel is a refined, versatile style that creates a broader, more well-defined upper body.

1099.name: Low Gorge Peak
1099.description: The lower gorge on this peak lapel is ideal for creating an overall more relaxed look without losing the bold appeal.

1100.name: Standard
1100.description: The standard width of our Low Gorge Notch lapel measures in at 10cm.

1101.name: Standard
1101.description: The standard width of our Low Gorge Peak lapel measures in at 11cm.

styles.name: Havana
styles.description: This style features natural shoulders, a notch lapel & jetted pockets.

styles.name: Milano
styles.description: This style features structured shoulders, a wide notch lapel & large flap pockets.

styles.name: Roma
styles.description: This style features a 2.5 button closure, wide notch lapels & jetted pockets.
